name: midnight-pool-contracts
description: Compact smart contract for Midnight Pool: stat commitments, threshold credentials, soulbound cue claims, and a provably-fair break-order coin flip.

scripts.compile: compact compile +0.31.1 midnight-pool.compact managed/midnight-pool && compact compile +0.31.1 stakes.compact managed/stakes
scripts.compile:fast: compact compile +0.31.1 --skip-zk midnight-pool.compact managed/midnight-pool && compact compile +0.31.1 --skip-zk stakes.compact managed/stakes
scripts.compile:devnet: compact compile +0.31.1 midnight-pool.compact devnet-deploy/managed-devnet/midnight-pool && compact compile +0.31.1 stakes.compact devnet-deploy/managed-devnet/stakes
scripts.format: compact format midnight-pool.compact && compact format stakes.compact
